Heavy rains cause landslides in Kerala; other regions forecast rain

Heavy rainfall has triggered landslides in Kerala, resulting in 25 deaths, four missing individuals, and 10 injuries. Eight districts in Kerala are under a 'red alert'. Separately, weather forecasts across various Indian regions predict rain, thunderstorms, and strong winds. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued alerts for several areas, including Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, and parts of Delhi, with some forecasts extending up to August 8.
